test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'While'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word to fill in blank number 2 is **"while".**
 
• The use of "while" in this context suggests that two things are happening simultaneously: traveling helps to decrease the risks of heart disease and anxiety and also contributes to developing our brain health.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Improving your well-being is considered to be the fundamental benefit of travelling. Travelling helps to decrease the risks of heart disease and anxiety **while **developing our brain health. There have been studies proving that travel can have a positive impact on our heart (3) ________. The health benefit of travelling is that when you travel to new surroundings you (4) ________ a restart button to your body and mind. This brings in fresh energy when you get back to your normal (5) ________ activities.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **"As" **generally indicates cause or reason, but in this context, it would mean that traveling reduces health risks because it develops brain health, which is not the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **"Because" **would mean that traveling reduces health risks due to the fact that it develops brain health, which again is not the intended meaning.
 
• **"So" **would indicate a result or effect, which is also not what the sentence is trying to express.
